segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for taking 4:10. My 2:30 got swallowed by getting the approval packet into deal desk, so I appreciate you sliding.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. I only have about twenty minutes, but we can cover the quote. We're looking at 42 seats now, not 38.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 42 seats. At that count you're at $54 per seat per month on an annual term, so $27,216 for the year before the onboarding fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: And onboarding was still $3,500? Finance asked if that can land on the first invoice or if it's separate.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It can be on the first invoice. I'll send the revised quote after I get the 42-seat line and billing contact to match in the CRM, likely by 6:00.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Billing contact is Mara Chen, mchen at northlake dot com. PO will probably be issued July 18 if legal is done.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That lines up. If signature is in by July 19, we can hold an August 5 go-live. The services team wanted ten business days for setup.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can we get our ops director on for fifteen minutes tomorrow morning? He just wants to confirm the data import format.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Nine is the only one I can't do, I'm held in the ops cleanup block then. I can do 10:30 or 1:00 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do 10:30. Send the invite to me and Mara, and I'll forward it to him.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the invite, revised quote, and the invoice layout in one email tonight.
